item.description:
Dax 3.6.0

  • Your iPhone: pair it from the phone button in Shepherd’s toolbar and Dax’s cards arrive as notifications. Answer an agent’s approval or question from the phone, follow your panes, and share a screenshot or file straight into an agent.
  • The File Drawer has a Finder of its own. Click the Finder face in its header to browse your folders inside the drawer and drag files out without opening Finder. The drawer also gained a text mode, and you can check several tiles to drag them together.
  • Shepherd’s pane titles say what each agent is doing. They follow the agent’s own title when it sets one and Dax’s short summary of what you asked when it doesn’t, and update as soon as you send something new. A pane with nothing to say yet shows the agent’s name.
  • DeepSeek joins Shepherd as a first-class agent, and a failed agent install shows its steps with a Fix with Claude or Codex button.
  • Agents can see every coding agent’s past sessions on this Mac, and get new tools to mark up pictures and the screen. Screen control now shows a visible cursor.
  • Screen Markup has a ruler, and the image viewer pages through several pictures.
